li.label: put the seat down
li.description: I asked the council to let me step down, and it did. I feel lighter for it.

li.label: trusted with a seat's work
li.description: The council asked me to do a seat's daily work while its holder rests. They trust me with it.

li.label: asked to carry on
li.description: I asked to put the seat down, and the council asked me to keep it. I said yes. I'm still tired.

li.label: my wish comes first
li.description: There was only enough for one of us, and the council promised it to me.

li.label: waiting my turn
li.description: There wasn't enough for both of us, so mine waits a little longer. At least I was told why.

li.label: the vote still stings
li.description: I lost my seat at the count. I keep thinking about it.

li.label: helped the new holder
li.description: I showed the new holder how the seat's work is done. Losing it doesn't bother me now.

li.label: someone I cared about sent away
li.description: The council sent away someone I was close to. The colony feels emptier.

li.label: better days
li.description: Things are better than they were a few days ago.

li.label: back to myself
li.description: I was worn down badly for a while. I'm back to myself now.

li.label: taken away from the work
li.description: A friend made me stop working for an evening. I didn't want to, and I'm glad I did.

li.label: made to rest
li.description: The council gave me a day off I didn't ask for. There was work to do.

li.label: they ate my best cooking
li.description: The whole colony sat down to my best cooking and cleared their plates.

li.label: told to keep to one helping
li.description: I was told in front of everyone to keep to one helping. I was hungry.

li.label: the kitchen is mine for a while
li.description: The council gave me the cooking for a few days. I mean to do it well.

li.label: a patch of my own
li.description: I have a little patch of ground of my own now, with my own seed in it.

li.label: company while laid up
li.description: Someone kept me company while I was stuck in the sickbed. It made the day go faster.

li.label: someone else's turn
li.description: Someone else is doing my share of the work for a few days. I needed that.

li.label: had to do it myself
li.description: The council left it to me, so I did it myself. It shouldn't have been mine to do.

li.label: played with an animal
li.description: I played with one of the animals all afternoon. It was the best day.

li.label: told not yet
li.description: I wanted to play with one of the animals and they said not yet.

li.label: a chair of my own
li.description: Someone made me a proper chair for my room. My back is grateful.

li.label: the best seat by the fire
li.description: I had the best seat by the fire tonight.

li.label: they let me speak
li.description: I said my piece in front of the colony, and they listened.

li.label: I named the newborn
li.description: The council chose my name for the newborn animal.

li.label: not my name for it
li.description: I had a better name for the newborn animal. Nobody asked me twice.

li.label: an animal of my own to handle
li.description: The council gave the animal to me to handle. It follows me now.

li.label: news from outside
li.description: I heard the news from the roads tonight. The world is bigger than this colony.

li.label: brought along
li.description: An old friend brought me along to the evening with the others.

li.label: apologised in front of everyone
li.description: I had to say sorry in front of the whole colony. I deserved it, and it still stung.

li.label: still sore with a friend
li.description: A friend and I fell out, and nobody has helped us make it up.

li.label: supper out of doors
li.description: We ate out of doors on the first warm evening of the year.

li.label: half an hour in the sun
li.description: We stopped work at noon to stand in the sun for a while.

li.label: warm at last
li.description: My room is warm at night now.

li.label: not alone in the storm
li.description: The storm was bad last night, but I wasn't alone in it.

li.label: alone in the storm
li.description: The storm went on half the night, and I lay awake through it.

li.label: the council saw it my way
li.description: I said what I thought, and the council went along with it.

li.label: made to give way
li.description: The council asked me to give way on something I cared about. I did, and I'm not happy about it.

li.label: learned from someone who knows
li.description: Someone who really knows the work showed me how it's done.

li.label: slept through the storm
li.description: There was a storm in the night. I slept through most of it.

li.label: has other friends now
li.description: We used to spend our evenings together. Now they spend them with someone else.

li.label: the night watch
li.description: Up half the night walking the walls, when my turn comes round. I hate every hour of it.

li.label: the night watch
li.description: Two of us out on the walls every night. It seems like a lot of lost sleep.

li.label: the night watch
li.description: Someone is awake on the walls every night. I sleep better for it.

li.label: the night watch
li.description: The walls are watched every night, and I like my turn at it.

li.label: a welcome for newcomers
li.description: An hour of small talk every evening by order of the council. I'd rather be left alone.

li.label: a welcome for newcomers
li.description: Evenings spent being friendly to people I barely know. It's tiring.

li.label: a welcome for newcomers
li.description: The new people are being made welcome. That's how it should be.

li.label: a welcome for newcomers
li.description: Every newcomer gets an evening with one of us. I'm proud of this colony.
